checkpoint.required_binary_gate: Only exact pinned110368038-byte artifact; verify digest before load, then restricted primitive-config/tensor-state schema/dimensions/finite weights. No permissive fallback for unsupported globals or malformed keys.

safe_execution_contract.loader_source: classifier._load_model calls torch.load(...map_location=cpu,weights_only=True) and requires config/state_dict. This is source inspection, not tested restoration.
safe_execution_contract.required_torch: Pin a maintained patched version with weights_only safety; do not use upstream minimum2.2 as security qualification. Recommend>=2.6, exact version still to pin.
forbidden: torch.serialization.add_safe_globals or allowlisting custom globals to force load
fixed_settings_for_later_registration: allow_auto_download=False; no implicit latest HF fetch
One checkpoint, one predeclared ensemble/normalization/configuration and seed; no outcome-selected setting
Class encoder classes_ must explicitly orient probability to Over, retain correct complementary side and abstention/push contracts
safe_execution_contract.restoration: Reconstruct from pinned binary plus qualified earlier examples/transforms in approved restricted route; persist only safe commitments/typed predictions/public aggregates. Do not serialize protected examples or estimator pickle to Git.

chronology_and_query_independence.fit_source_trace: fit fits TransformToNumerical and EnsembleGenerator using Xtrain/ytrain only. predict_proba transforms query and, withoutcache, combines stored train context with query rows for foundation inference.
chronology_and_query_independence.single_query_strategy: Call predict_proba with exactly one target query row at a time, preserving original training set. This prevents another later query feature vector entering the same forward pass by construction. It does not itself authenticate source vintage or all transductive internals.
still_required: Inspect/pin transformation code; preprocessing parameters must use earlier training only.
No target outcomes/in-context labels from evaluation game, repeated book or alternate offer of same player-game in training.
Future-query/outcome mutation and batch-versus-single equality checks within a declared independent decision batch; do not adapt after failed parity.
A new origin reconstructs contexts from eligible earlier offers; no cache or later fitted state can carry backward.
Single-query behavior/preprocessor determinism must be verified in canary before scored inference.
chronology_and_query_independence.source_limit: Classifier/estimator source read; lower-level attention/preprocessor modules not yet executed or comprehensively audited by child.

actual_offer_feasibility.availability_policy: Retained kickoff+7days strict< earliest weekly kickoff; same source-vintage caveats. Counts are feasibility, not new model grades.
actual_offer_feasibility.startup: A pilot could only have learned native contexts W7–9 under this rule; W5–6 require frozen explicit fallback/unavailable treatment. This does not establish five learned weeks or W1–9 complete-board coverage.
actual_offer_feasibility.earlier_A_W1_4: Protected source owned byA; public84-grade aggregates are not individual earlier training contexts.
actual_offer_feasibility.earlier_2022_2025: Ordinary football-stat labels do not supply authentic offered-line classifier labels. No qualifying earlier exact-offer row package identified in inspected own route.
actual_offer_feasibility.split_contract: Group all repeated player-game/threshold/book rows; no target-game labels, transforms, examples, calibration/retrieval/cache state in training. Half-point event orientation positiveclassOver; pushes need separate contract.

allocation.request_scope: One exact TabICLv2 completion-direction configuration, one ordinary same-information direct-classifier comparator, reused strongest saved distribution/direction controls; conditional W7–9 learned origins with declared W5–6startup. Not a granted additional allowance.
allocation.safe_stop: After qualification/canary, proceed only when observed cost projection for complete remaining inference/scoring/verification/retention fits both CPU/wall balances and180CPU reserve. Stop rather than silently shrink completed outcomes, swap model or add budget.
allocation.runtime_storage: 1GiB cap includes downloaded/compressed/unpacked dependencies, weights and temporary artifacts; checkpoint110MB alone does not prove runtime fits.
allocation.unavailable_context_or_retention: Exact earlier offers/contexts stay owner-qualified; protected context retention must use approved existing route, not public pickle/Git.
